source_statement.normalization: Paragraph whitespace collapsed to one ASCII space; UTF-8 without BOM; no terminal newline.

selections.resolved_meaning: Operations owns Camera Catalogue, Camera Detail, and Stream Diagnostics; connected Live Workspace and Monitor Wall surfaces handle media while Command Center remains the primary dashboard.
Use a same-origin H-CAM media edge with opaque short-lived grants; internal MediaMTX, camera locators, management locators, credentials, and reusable tokens remain server-only.
Use a typed hls.js and MSE baseline adapter, with native HLS admitted only through a safe same-origin authentication path that does not place bearer material in URLs.
Keep WHEP optional, default-off, pinned to draft-ietf-wish-whep-04 for this planning baseline, protected by an HLS fallback and kill switch, with no conformance claim.
Resolve the effective media profile as the fail-closed intersection of server, role/session, workspace, stream, browser, advisory capability, and measured resource ceilings.
Use a weighted deterministic scheduler based on explicit intent, pin and focus, visibility, health, and bounded stream, decode, and network budgets; never autoplay every saved tile.
Use a typed deterministic recovery state machine with bounded in-transport recovery, jittered reconnect, cooldown, circuit breaker, optional WHEP-to-HLS fallback, and manual terminal recovery.
Use one opaque short-lived grant per stream with bounded renewal, immediate revocation, idempotent close, and abandoned-session lease recovery.
Use revisioned server-side department and user layouts with opaque camera references and ETags; use memory-only state until the producer exists and prohibit protected browser persistence.

Provide view-only controls for open, pause/resume, mute, allowed quality, pin/focus/reorder/release, fullscreen, diagnostics, and reference-only handoff; recording, snapshots, downloads, exports, print, PTZ, and analytics remain absent.
Provide synchronized authoritative list, table, and status equivalence with complete keyboard, focus, non-color, announcement, pause/stop, stable-dimension, and reduced-motion behavior.

Require deterministic generated C1, C4, and C10 contract, browser, profile, security, accessibility, recovery, teardown, replay, hash, environment, and limitation evidence, followed only by a separately authorized owned-lab gate.

precedence_rules: The selected D-P5.3-001 topology keeps Command Center primary and places camera management under Operations with connected specialist media workspaces.
The selected HLS and WHEP choices do not authorize an exact dependency version, dependency resolution, media runtime, network destination, or provider.
The selected dynamic profile and scheduler choices change capacity and quality only; they never change operator authority, security, retention, or feature semantics.
The selected validation choice remains generated-only; Sentinel, real cameras, media, private data, and Government data remain prohibited.
The selected view-only controls do not activate Phase 2 PTZ or any recording, snapshot, download, export, print, analytics, or operational action.
